# ChangeManifest
## Rules
- `manifest.json` sole persistence file; schema/name/created identity immutable; history append-only.
- Track artifacts/files, hashes/drift, implementation files/links, `specDependsOn`, approvals and verification.
- Resolve delta/new-spec paths at creation; derive workspaces from `specIds`.
## Constraints
- Only `FsChangeRepository` reads/writes manifest.
- Legacy hydration preserves physical facts without invalidation.
